info.title: BotVisibility — AI Agent Readiness Scan & Answer Gateway
info.description: Pay-per-call AI-agent readiness audits and grounded Q&A. POST a URL to get a scored 58-check readiness report, or POST a URL plus a question to get a grounded, excerpt-cited answer that never fabricates. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Solana mainnet); only useful results bill.

post.summary: Generate an AI agent readiness report for a URL
post.description: Run the full BotVisibility audit on a URL: 58 checks across 5 levels (Discoverable, Usable, Optimized, Indexable, Agent-Native). Returns a scored, prioritized readiness report as Markdown. With no payment attached, the endpoint answers HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements (USDC on Solana mainnet); your wallet settles and retries, then the gateway returns the report.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 challenge (USDC or USDT on Solana mainnet).

502.description: Scan failed or did not complete in time; payment is not settled.

post.summary: Fetch a grounded, excerpt-cited answer from any website
post.description: Ask a question about any URL and get back a grounded answer at a fraction of the tokens of scraping the page yourself (typically 95-99% fewer). A deterministic grounding verifier requires every excerpt to be a verbatim substring of the fetched source and the answer to be fully covered by those excerpts, so it never fabricates — if the answer is not on the page you get an honest not_found. robots.txt and no-AI signals are always honored. Billing is enforced on-chain: HTTP 200 (settling the x402 payment) is returned only for state=answered; not_found, already_efficient, payment_required, and unreachable come back as 422 with the full result body and cost nothing.

example.question: how long does Stripe retry failed webhooks?

200.description: Grounded answer (state=answered) with verbatim excerpts, sources, and a token-economics receipt. This is the only response that settles the payment.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 challenge (USDC or USDT on Solana mainnet).

422.description: Terminal non-answered result (not_found, already_efficient, payment_required, or unreachable) with the full result body. The payment is not settled — these outcomes are free.

post.summary: Create a prepaid Answer Gateway API key
post.description: One x402 payment of $5.00 returns a Bearer key with 1,000 answered-question credits ($0.005 per answer — half the pay-per-request rate). Use the key as `Authorization: Bearer bvag_...` against POST https://botvisibility.com/api/answer. Only answered responses consume credits. The raw key is shown once in this response and only its SHA-256 hash is stored, so save it immediately.

200.description: The new prepaid API key and its credit balance. The key is shown only once.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 challenge (USDC or USDT on Solana mainnet).

url.description: The site to scan, e.g. https://stripe.com
The page to answer from, e.g. https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks. Redirects are re-validated per hop; robots.txt and no-AI signals are always honored.

question.description: The natural-language question to answer from that page, e.g. "how long does Stripe retry failed webhooks?"
question.example: how long does Stripe retry failed webhooks?

AnswerResponse.description: One response shape for all terminal states; branch on `state`.

state.description: Terminal state. `answered`: grounded answer or verified excerpts. `not_found`: the answer is not in the source within the 3-fetch cap. `already_efficient`: the page is already token-lean — fetch `direct_url` yourself. `payment_required`: the source page itself returned HTTP 402; its x402 quote is in `payment`. `unreachable`: policy block, HTTP error, or timeout (see `reason`). Only `answered` bills.

confidence.description: `high`: composed answer fully covered by verbatim excerpts. `medium`: verified excerpts only, no composed answer.

answer.description: The grounded answer, present when state=answered with high confidence.
answer.example: Stripe retries failed webhook deliveries for up to three days with exponential backoff.

excerpts.description: Verbatim substrings of the fetched source that ground the answer.

text.description: Verbatim excerpt text from the source.

lines.description: Line range in the distilled source, e.g. "142-145".

sources.description: Pages fetched to produce the answer (hard cap: 3 fetches per request).

route.description: Fetch route used: llms_txt, markdown, openapi, or html_distill.

receipt.description: Per-call token-economics receipt (the Agent Tax, measured).

raw_tokens_at_source.description: Tokens the raw page(s) would have cost to read directly.

reduction.description: Token reduction as a percentage string.

est_tax_avoided_usd.description: Estimated dollar value of tokens you did not have to read.

source_cost_usd.description: What the source page itself charged (paid web via buy-side x402), 0 for free pages.

direct_url.description: Present when state=already_efficient: fetch this token-lean URL yourself.

payment.description: Present when state=payment_required: the source page's own x402 quote (a price, not a block).

reason.description: Present when state=unreachable: policy, HTTP error, or timeout detail.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the key, e.g. "my agent".

api_key.description: The prepaid Bearer key (prefix bvag_). Shown once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

PaymentRequired.description: x402 payment challenge returned before payment.

accepts.description: x402 payment options. Solana mainnet, USDC or USDT.
